newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet prices steady to firmer in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet prices steady to firmer in dull trade.

text.p: NWE jet fuel prices were steady to slightly firmer in line with benchmark gas oil futures but physical activity remained dull.
Traders said barge and cargo premiums were stable but relaxed trade meant the market was becoming notional with both buyers, apart from some light buying interest into the U.K., and sellers relaxed.
They said the market was generally balanced.
Barges were assessed around August IPE +$16/18 a tonne fob ARA with cargoes up a similar amount at August IPE +$17/+$19 a tonne cif NWE.
